title: Person-Centric Annotations of LAION-400M: Auditing Bias and Its Transfer to Models
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical topic association with intersectional identities (race/ethnicity and gender) in the LAION-400M dataset, where religion was one of the primary identified topics via Sparse Autoencoders.
findings: The analysis found strong associations between specific religions and certain intersectional identities, reflecting cultural and regional stereotypes in the LAION-400M dataset. Key associations included 'Islam' with Middle Eastern and South Asian identities, 'Buddhism' with Southeast Asian identities, 'Indian religions' with South Asian identities, and 'Mormonism' with Latino identities. These findings highlight how web-scale data encodes and perpetuates religious stereotypes tied to specific demographic groups.
